description: This file defines the interface 'WeightedEvaluation' for evaluating weighted statistics. It specifies methods for calculating a weighted statistic over arrays of values and weights, including bounds for evaluating specific segments.

classes.name: WeightedEvaluation
classes.description: Interface for weighted statistical evaluations, providing methods to compute weighted statistics over data arrays with or without specifying a subset.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the weighted statistic over the entire input array using provided weights.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the weighted statistic over a subset of the input array, specified by beginning index and length, using provided weights.
